Hi Anika —

Thanks again for your time yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in a 60–75 minute workshop to:
- walk through your expected Q2 token/embedding volumes,
- validate Dedicated capacity sizing scenarios, and
- align packaging/pricing options tied to the forecast.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu 2026-03-12 10:00–11:15
- Thu 2026-03-12 14:00–15:15
- Fri 2026-03-13 09:00–10:15

Agenda attached (dedicated-sizing-agenda.pdf). Could you confirm which slot works best and who from your side should join (we recommend Eng, Procurement, and Security for the full review)?

If helpful, Dev will prep a quick workload-to-cost sketch from the initial metrics you shared. Can you also drop the latest monthly forecast as a CSV before the call?

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Tessa
